contract: arcade-contract.js contains verbatim geometryCache through morphGeometry and hoverCallout from arcade.js. Full original arcade.js retained as an unloaded reference.
adaptation: Standalone host with native Arcade geometry/territory pipeline. Configurator 8 receives the completed explorer mesh through g2.js; one of fourteen operations, no reset or disabled original controls. Six-, seven- and earlier ten-number addresses remain readable. No manuscript or score generated.
spin_all: Header VE transfers actual pointer angular increments and release velocity to all eight side panes. Starting orientations are preserved; gesture response and 4000 ms decay are shared. Seven setting panes select on stop; Explore remains explicit. All original influence panes stay active. No randomness.
momentum_revision: Configurator and shared-controller exponential decay increased from 800 ms to 4000 ms, preserving measured release velocity and the stop threshold. Five times the coast distance and decay duration for the same input, response and starting state. Subject preview remains at its native 1400 ms.
main_menu: Native Arcade foyer VE, front-first facet ordering at yaw pi/4, pitch asin(1/sqrt(3)), roll pi/4, camera distance 4.5. Above fourteen destinations, native expanded-room subdivision and compaction. All populations pass through verbatim facetTerritories with width 1; physical facets map to semantic destinations through faceItems. Native callout positions and complete-facet eligibility. Standalone address persistence/search and direct navigation remain host adaptations.

mtheory.contract: Completed native explorer mesh -> declared seven-coordinate lift / incident normals -> selected G2 operation -> geometryFromCells -> native territory labels and renderer. Fourteen choices. Optional additional initial conditions remain possible; no separate initial-condition form is required by these operations.
mtheory.address: Six native fields plus one facet index. Earlier ten-field sections are retained by mtheory.js for existing saved addresses.

renderer_extension: Optional setGeometry(..., preserveWinding=false): true retains supplied face winding for non-star-shaped section meshes. Original radial normal adjustment remains the default for all native geometry. Mathematical sections use existing cell surface=true to omit VE core.

mobile_rendering.contract: Coarse-pointer / Android uses one native VERenderer and WebGL2 context; view facades retain meshes and controls, draw sequentially through native shaders and copy completed frames into 2D display canvases. No geometric approximation or new score.
mobile_rendering.limits: 256-pixel side labels; 512-pixel main labels; one 24 MiB GPU label cache; displayed canvas DPR ≤1.5 with ≤1.2 million pixels per view. Desktop keeps the native per-view path.
mobile_rendering.reproduction: Before this change, Chromium with max-active-webgl-contexts=8 evicted the menu and central lab contexts (11 created). Actual Pixel Fold Edge crash not directly inspected.
